name: HedgeyFinance
fix_description: In createLockedCampaign, validate that claimLockup.tokenLocker and donation.tokenLocker are whitelisted/authorized locker contracts. The function approves campaign tokens (via safeIncreaseAllowance) to user-supplied tokenLocker addresses without validation, allowing attackers to specify a malicious locker that steals the approved tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, straightforward exploit: take a flash loan, create a malicious campaign to obtain approval/state corruption, cancel it, then drain funds with transferFrom. It involves only a couple of protocol interactions and no complex math, routing, or deep protocol internals, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
